items.name: theme
items.title: Mireye theme
items.description: The Mireye tokens and the Tailwind names that read them.

site.--ds-font-mono: var(--font-dm-mono, "DM Mono"), ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
site.--ds-font-code: var(--font-dm-mono, "DM Mono"), ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

items.name: about-page
items.useFor: Use for /about. Pass `story` paragraphs, `figures` and `beliefs`; the closing card points at careers by default.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): about page and pages-company.css
items.title: About page
items.description: The about page template: the company line as the title, the story beside a survey plate, figures in DM Mono on a ruled grid, beliefs as solid-node bullets, and a closing card for careers.

items.name: accordion
items.useFor: Use for details people open one at a time (how a check works, the layers behind a value) or for groups of a site's facts. Pass type="single" collapsible for one open at a time, type="multiple" for several. Keep the label a short phrase; the content is 13px secondary text, values or fields.
constraints: Boxing each item in a card
A chevron that moves on hover
items.source: Not in Figma: Mist rules from Cited fields (443:470) and the arrow head from UI · Buttons (442:3), for a designer's review
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open in place: 13px Forest labels ruled by 1px Mist lines, with Mireye's chevron at the right that turns when open.

items.name: agent-chat
items.useFor: Put a conversation in `ChatPanel` (title, `onClose`, `footer` for the composer; `framed` for the cut corner and header nodes). In the empty state show `MapStrip` and `ChatSuggestions`; wrap the composer in `SurveyFrame` and put `ChatFollowUps` on it after an answer. `ProfileChart` draws an elevation profile in ticks.
constraints: Sliding parts in; they enter in place
A chat without the site it is about
items.source: Figma chat explorations (434:2): "Chat 12" and "Chat 16"
items.title: Agent chat
items.description: The Ask Mireye panel built from the system's parts: the panel, a map strip, suggestions, follow-ups, the survey frame and an elevation profile.

items.name: agent-steps
items.useFor: Use while an agent works. Give each step a `status` from the run, or `frame`. `live` shows steps as they start, shimmers the current label and draws a rail between nodes. `size="sm"` is the glyph for a tile. `running` loops a demo.
items.source: Figma "UI · Loaders, agent" (443:234): 443:327 to 443:383
items.title: Agent steps
items.description: What the agent is doing: steps as nodes and labels, done, current or pending, with a live mode that reports as a run does.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.useFor: Use to confirm an action that is destructive or hard to undo (remove a site, rescore every site). Name the action on the confirming key (Remove site), never just OK. Use size="sm" with AlertDialogMedia for a short centered question. Content taller than the screen fades at an edge (fade-y) where more scrolls past it.
constraints: Information that needs no answer (use a toast)
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dialog's panel
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: The dialog's framed cut panel for a confirmation: a 16px regular title, a line in the secondary ink and two keys at the end; no close key, and a click outside does not dismiss it.

items.name: alert
items.useFor: Use default for a fact the person should know before reading on (values are cited), warning for data that is partial or stale, success for a finished report, destructive for a source that failed. Lead with a Phosphor glyph at regular weight. Put a short note or one button in AlertAction. Use muted inside a Bone panel.
constraints: More than one alert for one message
items.source: Not in Figma (no risk or warning state yet): the cut frame of UI · Agent chat (443:433) with the chosen status colours, for a designer's review
items.title: Alert
items.description: A note in the cut frame: a 1px line around Bone with the chamfer at the top-left, a 16px glyph, a medium title and a secondary description. The line takes a status colour for success, warning and errors; muted is Fog.

items.name: animated-counter
items.useFor: Use for counts that change in place: parcels screened, requirements met. `animation="count"` (default) counts in 0.4s on a quint ease-out; `animation="roll"` rolls each digit on a spring with no bounce. The first render is still; under reduced motion the number swaps at once.
constraints: Animating a number on first render
Counters on values the person types
items.source: Not in Figma; motion follows the system's ease-out
items.title: Animated counter
items.description: A number that animates to its new value: counting through every value, or rolling each digit.

items.name: app-shell
items.useFor: Use as the base of every product screen. Pass `nav` groups, the `current` row id, `title`, `breadcrumb`, `meta` and `actions` (one Forest key at most), and the screen as children. It fills the viewport; give it a height class to embed it. Below 768px the rail opens as a sheet.
constraints: Two Forest keys in the header
items.source: brand/reference product UI boards (Figma 442:2) and the library's product parts: sidebar, breadcrumb
items.title: App shell
items.description: The app's frame: the 212px Bone rail (lockup, rows, labelled groups, Help and the workspace), a 56px header with breadcrumb, title, mono meta and actions over a Stone rule, and a scrolling content slot.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.useFor: Wrap an aerial or photo in AspectRatio with ratio={16 / 9} (or 4 / 3, 1) so it keeps its shape at every width, and clip it with overflow-hidden. Dim it with ds-imagery when marks or a parcel outline sit on top, so the marks read first.
constraints: Stock photos where a place is not shown
items.source: Brand principles: real photos only as accents, where a place needs to be shown; ds-imagery from brand/utilities.css
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A frame that holds an aerial, a map tile or a site photo at a fixed shape, square-cornered.

items.name: attachment
items.useFor: Use for a file attached to a question or produced by a report (a parcel export, a site plan, a KML boundary). Show the size or the upload state in AttachmentDescription. Add AttachmentTrigger to open the file and AttachmentAction for remove, retry or download. Use orientation="vertical" for images and AttachmentGroup for a row of files. A row of attachments fades at the side (fade-x) where more scroll past it.
items.source: Figma UI · Inputs (442:107): the field's cut frame and the site chip's Fog, at the product scale
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file in the Bone cut frame with a 6px chamfer: a square Fog tile with the file's glyph, the name in Forest and its size in DM Mono; uploading names shimmer, failed files take the danger line.

items.name: auth-page
items.useFor: Use for sign in (`mode="sign-in"`) and sign up (`mode="sign-up"`). Pass `onSubmit`, `onSso` and the links; the template signs no one in.
constraints: Social login buttons in brand colors
Placeholder text as the only label
items.source: brand/reference product UI boards (Figma 442:2) and the library's product parts: field, input, button (Figma UI · Inputs 442:79 and Buttons 442:3)
items.title: Auth page
items.description: Sign in and sign up: the form on the left (lockup, title, fields, the Forest key, single sign-on under a ruled "or", the switch to the other mode) and a survey plate on the right from 1024px.

items.name: avatar
items.useFor: Use for an organisation, a team member or a site's thumbnail beside its name (size sm is 24px in rows). Always give an AvatarFallback with one uppercase initial. AvatarBadge marks someone or something live with a Fern diamond; AvatarGroup lists who shares a project, with AvatarGroupCount for the rest.
items.source: Not in Figma: square because Mireye has no circles; Fog and Forest from the palette (331:37), for a designer's review
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Square tiles: one Forest initial on Fog, or an image filling the square, with a diamond status node and a group.

items.name: badge
items.useFor: Use the default Fog tag for a value that describes a site (345 kV, 41.2 ac, Zone X, I-2 Industrial). Use variant="outline" with a BadgeMark for a record's state: state="verified" (solid diamond), "loading" (three bars) or "queued" (outlined diamond). Use inverse for a tag on a map or photo, count for a small number beside a label, and success, warning or destructive only when the colour carries a verdict (Passes, Partial data, In a flood zone).
constraints: A cut corner on a badge
More than one inverse badge in a row
items.title: Badge
items.description: Square 24px tags and statuses: Fog data tags for site values, the Forest inverse tag, and the Bone status pill led by a diamond (Verified, Loading, Queued).

items.name: blog-page
items.useFor: Use for /blog. Pass `posts` (ISO dates) and `topics`. The first post in the current topic leads.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): blog page and ResourcePages
items.title: Blog page
items.description: The blog index: the title, topic tabs that filter at once, the newest post as a lead with a survey plate, the rest as ruled rows (date in DM Mono, title, one line, a Fog topic tag) and pagination.

items.name: blog-post-page
items.useFor: Use for a post. Pass the post's fields and the article as `children` (typography items); the sample article shows the pattern, including a cited figure.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): blog post layout; typography from the library
items.title: Blog post page
items.description: A blog post: breadcrumb, topic, the title, the byline with the date in DM Mono, then the article in the typography items at a 680px measure with a cited figure.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.useFor: Use above a page head when a page sits inside a hierarchy of places or records (Texas, Ellis County, Site 14). Fold middle levels into BreadcrumbEllipsis when the trail is long; use asChild to render your router's link. A small outlined Diamond can replace the slash in a trail of map places.
constraints: A breadcrumb on a top-level page
Links that move or underline on hover
items.source: Not in Figma: built from the text tints and Slate, for a designer's review
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of 13px muted links ending in the current place in Forest, with a Slate slash between, like a path.

items.name: bubble
items.useFor: Use inside Message for each piece of a conversation with the agent. Use the default Bone frame with align end for what the person asked, ghost for the agent's answer (it reads like a report), secondary for a short reply or a note from another agent, muted for a system note and destructive for a question that failed. Stack consecutive bubbles in a BubbleGroup. BubbleReactions pins a short tag (2 sources) to an edge.
constraints: A cut corner anywhere but the top-left
An entrance animation on each bubble
items.source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Message, at the product scale
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A message in the Figma cut frame: Bone with the 1px Stone line and the 8px chamfer, Fog for replies, Mist for system notes, Forest when one must lead, or plain text for the agent's answer.

items.name: button-group
items.useFor: Use for a set of related actions or a split key (an action and its options), a field with a fixed unit or prefix (ButtonGroupText), or a vertical zoom pair on a map. Nest groups for 8px between sets.
constraints: Rounded or separately cut keys inside one bar
Mixing filled and framed keys in one bar
A group of more than five keys (use a Select or a menu)
items.source: Drawn from Figma "UI · Buttons" (442:3) and "UI · Inputs" (442:107); the design has no joined keys
items.title: Button group
items.description: Keys joined into one bar: the first keeps the cut corner, the others square off and share a 1px line. Holds fields, selects and a Fog text segment for a fixed prefix or suffix.

items.name: button
items.useFor: Use one default key per view for the action that moves the task forward (Find sites), with `arrow` for a forward action. Use outline for the actions beside it and for icon keys (size icon, always with aria-label), ghost for a low-weight action inside content (add `arrow` when it goes somewhere), secondary for a quiet key in a toolbar or on a dark ground, destructive for the one destructive action in a dialog, and link for an action inside text. Set `loading` while the action runs: the key keeps its size and ignores clicks. Use size sm (32px) for the chat Ask key and dense rows.
constraints: A hatch, outline, shadow or size change on hover
An arrow or icon that moves on hover
A spinner other than the Dial or the tick bar
Two Forest keys side by side
items.source: Figma "UI · Buttons" (442:3): Primary, Secondary, Text and Icon rows in Default, Hover, Loading and Disabled; the chat Ask key (443:464)
items.title: Button
items.description: Mireye's keys with the cut corner: the Forest primary (default), the framed secondary (outline, a Forest line on Bone), a Fog key (secondary), the text button (ghost: an 80% Forest label that turns Forest), destructive and link. 36px tall with 16px sides and a 13px medium label; the fill steps once on hover and back at once on press. Loading walks a tick bar, or turns the Dial on icon keys.

items.name: calendar
items.useFor: Use inside the date picker, or on its own where a month is always in view (a site visit schedule). Supports single days, several days and ranges.
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Diamond node of Figma UI · Status and tags (442:177) for today
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid of square 36px day keys: Fog under the pointer, Forest for the chosen day, a Fog band across a range, Slate outside days, and a small Forest diamond under today.

items.name: card
items.useFor: Use the default card for a block of facts about one thing (a site, a source, a requirement): a 16px regular title, a muted description, Fog tags or values in CardContent and an action in CardAction or CardFooter. Use muted for a group of values inside a Bone panel, and inverse for the one card that leads (the best fit). Put cards on the canvas; inside a Bone panel prefer rules over nested cards.
constraints: A cut corner anywhere but the top-left
More than one inverse card on a screen
Nesting cards more than one level
items.source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): the message panel's cut frame, at the product scale
items.title: Card
items.description: The Bone cut frame (a 1px Stone line with the 8px chamfer at the top-left), the Fog card with no line and the Forest inverse card. Square everywhere else, no shadow.

items.name: careers-page
items.useFor: Use for /careers. Pass `roles` (title, team, location, href) and the team's own `principles` and `story`.
constraints: A real person's name in the sample copy
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): careers page (ResourcePages CareersPage) and pages-company.css
items.title: Careers page
items.description: The careers page: the line as the title, why the work matters, how the team works as ruled rows with solid nodes, and the open roles as rows with a mono location.

items.name: carousel
items.useFor: Use to page through a set of similar cards when space is short (matching sites, photos of one site). Give each CarouselItem a basis for how many show at once. Leave room either side for the arrow keys, or place them yourself.
constraints: Dots as the only way to move
Slides of different heights in one row
items.source: Not in Figma: square keys in the Stone line with the arrow of UI · Buttons (442:3), for a designer's review
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides that snap into place, with square Bone previous and next keys in the 1px Stone line and Mireye's arrow, outside it.

items.name: changelog-page
items.useFor: Use for /changelog. Pass `entries`, newest first; mark fixes with `kind: "fix"`. Wrap code names in backticks.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): resource pages; the survey line and nodes from the brand's steps
items.title: Changelog page
items.description: The changelog: entries on a survey line (a solid node for a release, outlined for a fix), date and version in DM Mono, a title, a paragraph, Fog area tags and solid-node bullets.

items.name: chart
items.useFor: Use for a measure across a few categories or along a distance or time (sites per county, elevation along a parcel, interconnection requests per year). Wrap the chart in ChartContainer with a config naming each series; colors default to the series tokens in order. Add ChartTooltip with ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegend with ChartLegendContent. Use a pie only for shares of one whole with three or four parts (land use).
items.source: LAND fit-score and compare-matrix (tick and line look) and the ds-draw motion; chart series tokens from the palette (331:37)
items.title: Chart
items.description: SVG bar, line, area and pie charts in the survey-sheet look: 1px lines, square bars, diamond points, flat fills in the chart series colors, a solid Mist grid, lines that draw in from the left like a plotter, and a cut-frame tooltip.

items.name: chat-input
items.useFor: Use under a conversation. Pass `placeholder`, `site` (a SiteChip), `textareaProps` for the value and an `onSubmit`. `submitDisabled` disables Ask and Enter while the question is empty; `loading` keeps Enter from sending while the agent answers; `compact` makes Ask the chip's height.
constraints: A send icon in place of Ask
A composer taller than its question
items.source: Figma "UI · Agent chat" (443:433): frame 443:455
items.title: Chat input
items.description: The composer: a text area that grows with the question, the site chip and Ask, in the large cut frame.

items.name: chat-message
items.useFor: Use for each sent question, right-aligned above the agent's steps and answer. Set its width with a class; the text wraps inside the padding.
items.source: Figma "UI · Agent chat" (443:433): 443:441
items.title: Chat message
items.description: The question the person sent: their words in the cut frame on Bone.

items.name: chat-steps
items.useFor: Use under the question once the agent has worked: "Matched the parcel", "Checked the flood zone". Steps join as they finish; StreamText fades their words in.
constraints: Present tense once a step is done
A spinner on a step; use AgentSteps for live work
items.source: Figma "UI · Agent chat" (443:433): 443:445 to 443:453
items.title: Chat steps
items.description: What the agent did to answer, in the past tense, each step behind an outlined diamond.

items.name: chat
items.useFor: Compose a turn from the sent `ChatMessage`, the agent's `ChatSteps` in the past tense, the answer and its CitedFields, then `ChatInput` with a SiteChip. Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a line; `loading` walks Ask's ticks while the agent answers. AgentChat puts the whole panel together.
constraints: Agent steps in the present tense once done
A composer without a visible label or placeholder
items.source: Figma "UI · Agent chat" (443:433)
items.title: Chat
items.description: The parts of a conversation with the agent: ChatMessage, ChatSteps and ChatInput, the composer.

items.name: checkbox
items.useFor: Use for independent options applied when a form is submitted (exclude floodplain, layers to show). Pass the label as children so a click on it toggles the box. Use the indeterminate state for a parent that covers some of its children. For a setting that applies at once use Switch.
constraints: A checkbox that acts at once like a switch
items.source: Figma "UI · Controls" (442:145): Exclude floodplain, on and off
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 16px square with no cut: Bone inside a 1px Stone line when off, Forest with Mireye's Bone check when on, Forest with a Bone rule when mixed. An empty box steps to Fog under the pointer. Its label is 13px Forest 12px after it.

items.name: cited-fields
items.useFor: Use under an answer to show the values it read ("Flood zone, Zone X, 1"). Each `CitedField` takes a label, its value as children and a source number; put them in `CitedFields`, and both under a `SourceGroup` with the `Sources` list so pointing links them.
constraints: More than one value per row
items.source: Figma "UI · Agent chat" (443:433): rows 443:471 to 443:487
items.title: Cited fields
items.description: The values an agent answer reports, each with its label and source chip, between Mist rules.

items.name: code-block
items.useFor: Use to show a response, a request or a snippet someone will read or copy (an answer's JSON with its sources, an API call). Give it a CodeBlockHeader with the file name and a CodeBlockCopyButton, then CodeBlockContent with the code and its language. Pass wrap for long single values. The code fades at an edge (fade-xy) where more lines or columns scroll past it.
constraints: Highlight colors outside the code tokens
items.source: Mireye docs site spec (DM Mono commands and code in cut-frame windows) and the code tokens in brand/tokens.css
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code in a cut-frame window: a Bone block in the 1px Stone line with the chamfer at the top-left, a Fog head with the file name and a square copy key, DM Mono at 12px with line numbers and a quiet palette theme.

items.name: collapsible
items.useFor: Use for one optional group (search settings under a query, the layers behind a value). Make the trigger the whole row: a 13px label with Mireye's chevron (ArrowRightIcon with head, turned 90 degrees) at the right that turns when open. In a cut-frame panel let the content open at once (see Section). For several sections, use Accordion.
constraints: Animating anything but the content height and the chevron's turn
A chevron that moves on hover
items.source: Not in Figma: built from the arrow head (UI · Buttons, 442:3) and the cut frame, for a designer's review
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A part that shows and hides in place, opening with its height; the trigger is the row it sits in.

items.name: combobox
items.useFor: Use to pick a place or record by name from a long list (a county, a parcel, a saved site), or several values (map layers) with ComboboxChips. Pass `detail` for the state or acreage, and `searching` on ComboboxInput while the parent's search runs (the Dial turns). The list fades at an edge (fade-y) where more options scroll past it.
constraints: A spinner other than the Dial
Animating rows as the highlight moves (it follows the keys)
items.source: The design's search field with floating results (not in Figma yet), drawn with the field (442:107)
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable choice: the select's trigger, and a list in the field's frame with a 36px search row (the parcel glyph) and 28px rows whose typed part is full Forest. The highlighted row is a Fog plate with the small cut; chosen rows are full Forest with a solid diamond. Rows can carry a short detail (a state). ComboboxChips holds several values as square Fog chips.

items.name: command
items.useFor: Use for a command menu (open it with Cmd K through CommandDialog) and for searchable lists of sites, layers and pages. Give items a 16px Phosphor glyph and a shortcut where there is one. The list fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: An open or close animation on the command dialog
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the review build's combobox (Bone cut frame, Fog highlight)
items.title: Command
items.description: A Bone panel with the 8px cut corner and a 1px Stone line: a 44px search row over the Mist rule, groups headed in the secondary ink and square 32px rows with Fog under the selection.

items.name: compare-matrix
items.useFor: Use to compare finalists. Pass `sites`, `requirements` (with each site's result), optional `notes` and `market`. A failing Must cell fills Fog with a Forest bar; `activeRequirement` steps the other rows back. `onAddSite` and `onRemoveSite` add and remove columns; columns that stay glide. On narrow screens the table scrolls in its own region with the requirement column pinned. On a narrow screen the end edge fades (fade-x-end) and cells fade under the pinned column (fade-under) as they scroll.
items.source: Not in Figma yet; built from the product survey of the Compare screen
items.title: Compare matrix
items.description: Two to four sites side by side against the same requirements, with fit, notes and a tally.

items.name: contact-page
items.useFor: Use for /contact. Pass `channels`, `topics` and `onSubmit`; the template sends nothing itself.
constraints: Maps or photos of an office
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): contact flow; fields from the library (Figma UI · Inputs 442:79)
items.title: Contact page
items.description: The contact page: the title and channels (a mono label over each link) beside a form in a cut frame (name, work email, topic, message, the Forest key) that says it was sent in place.

items.name: context-menu
items.useFor: Use for the actions on a thing people point at directly (a parcel on the map or in a list), as a shortcut to actions that are also reachable another way. A long menu fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: The only way to reach an action
Rounded corners or a shadow on the panel
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dropdown menu's panel and rows
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: The dropdown menu's panel on right-click or long-press: a Bone frame with the 6px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, square 32px rows with Fog under the highlight, Mist while pressed, and Mireye's check on a chosen row.

items.name: contour-loader
items.useFor: Use while terrain or a map loads: `size={200}` where the map will be, `size={56}` in a tile. `running={false}` with `frame` holds Figma's still frame.
constraints: Over data that is not terrain
items.source: Figma "UI · Loaders" (443:2): hero 443:9, frames 443:16 to 443:44
items.title: Contour loader
items.description: The map loader: four terrain contours around a survey node, with a pulse rippling outwards.

items.name: cta-section
items.useFor: Use once, as the last section before the footer. `tone="dark"` uses a Fog key on Forest; `light` uses the Forest key and an outlined one. Keep the title to one line.
constraints: A Forest key on the Forest panel
Gradients or photos in the panel
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HomeClosing and closing-card.css (the closing window)
items.title: CTA section
items.description: The closing card: a large cut panel (Forest, or a Bone frame with a Forest line) with the title, one line, the page's last two actions and a still tick row along its foot.

items.name: dashboard-page
items.useFor: Use as a product's home screen. Pass `stats`, `usage`, `sites` and `runs`; replace the survey plate with the product's map in an app.
constraints: Round status dots (use the status pill)
items.source: brand/reference product UI boards (Figma 442:2) and the library's product parts: card, fit-score, status, progress, table, map
items.title: Dashboard page
items.description: The overview in the app shell: figures in DM Mono with the month's usage as a tick bar, the active search on a survey plate beside its shortlist with fit chips, and the latest runs with status pills.

items.name: data-table
items.useFor: Use for a list of records people sort, filter, select and page through (sites for a buy box, parcels in a county, saved searches): pass columns (id, header, an accessor for sorting and filtering, a cell), data and getRowId. Lead with SiteCell, align numbers right with NumberCell (one decimal, a unit) and write Not recorded for a missing value. Turn on selectable for bulk actions and put them in toolbar; set pageSize and pageSizes for long lists. For a short fixed list, use Table.
constraints: A frame around the table and the toolbar together
Animating rows when sorting or paging
Selection shown only by a row tint
Empty cells where a value is missing
items.source: LAND data-table (the Leads sites table: header rule, Mist rows, SiteCell, NumberCell) and cited-fields (443:433)
items.title: Data Table
items.description: The site list: a filter field and a Columns menu over Mireye's ruled table, sortable heads with Mireye's arrow head, row checkboxes, site cells with an aerial and a DM Mono parcel ID, and the pager.

items.name: date-picker
items.useFor: Use for one date (survey date, site visit) or a range (permit window) in a form. Add presets for the common choices (Today, Next week).
constraints: Free text date entry without a picker
A picker for a time of day
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) for the field at the product scale, and the popover's panel
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A 36px field with the 8px cut corner and a 1px Stone line (Forest with focus) that opens a month grid in the popover's panel, with optional presets as square rows ending in Mireye's check.

items.name: dial
items.useFor: Use as the spinner: on an icon key while it works (24), inline (36) or where a whole panel waits (140). `running={false}` with `head` holds a still frame. It is named "Loading" while it runs.
constraints: A smooth spinning wheel or a circle spinner
More than one dial in view
A dial without words nearby saying what is loading, outside an icon key
items.source: Figma "UI · Buttons" (442:76) and "UI · Loaders" (443:2)
items.title: Dial
items.description: Mireye's spinner: ticks around a circle with a Forest head fading to Mist, turning one tick a step.

items.name: dialog
items.useFor: Use for a short task that must be finished or dismissed before going back to the page (create a site, name an export). Put the fields in DialogBody and the main action last. DialogBody fades at an edge (fade-y) where more content scrolls past it.
constraints: A dialog for a destructive confirmation (use Alert Dialog)
a shadow or a blurred scrim
A scale from less than 98 percent
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Bone cut frame of Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) at the card's 8px cut, and the brand's 40 percent Forest scrim token
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A Bone panel with the 8px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, no shadow, on the page under Forest at 40 percent; a 16px regular title, a square 32px close key, 20px sides; full screen on phones.

items.name: diamond
items.useFor: Use wherever a circle would mark a point: a map node, a step, a status, a list bullet. `variant="solid"` is confirmed or done, `variant="outline"` is pending or empty; give `fill` (the ground color) when lines behind should stop at the node. Pass Figma's size in px; it renders at the product scale. The color follows the text color.
constraints: Circles or dots for nodes and bullets
Colored nodes; they take the ink or Stone
items.source: Figma UI boards (442:2): the node on the map, steps, status and radio
items.title: Diamond
items.description: The survey node: a square turned 45 degrees, solid or outlined, that marks map points, steps, statuses, bullets and the radio.

items.name: direction
items.useFor: Wrap an app or a section in DirectionProvider dir="rtl" when its language reads right to left, and set dir on the element too. Menus, sliders, tabs and carousels then flip their keyboard and layout direction.
constraints: Mixing directions inside one menu or form
items.source: Radix Direction; no visual of its own
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left for every component inside it.

items.name: docs-page
items.useFor: Use for product documentation. Pass `groups` for the rail and `sections` (with optional `code`).
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): docs route and interior.css; the code block is the library's
items.title: Docs page
items.description: A documentation page: a contents rail on wide screens, the title and a lead, then sections of prose with code blocks at a 680px measure.

items.name: drawer
items.useFor: Use on phones for a choice or short task that comes from the bottom of the screen (choose a basemap). People can drag or flick it away. The body fades at an edge (fade-xy) where more content scrolls past it, either way.
constraints: A drawer that cannot be dismissed by dragging
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the sheet
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A square Bone panel pulled from an edge with a 1px Stone line on its inner edge, a square Stone handle, and a drag that follows the finger; it slides on the drawer curve.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.useFor: Use for actions on one thing behind a single control (a site's or parcel's row actions), and for small option sets with DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (map layers) or DropdownMenuRadioItem (units). Mark a destructive action with variant="destructive" and keep it last, after a separator. A long menu fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: Navigation between pages in a dropdown
More than one level of submenu
Rounded corners or a shadow on the panel
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the review build's combobox and unit select lists (Bone cut frame, Stone line, Fog highlight), Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) for the frame and the checkbox (442:161) for the check
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A Bone panel with the 6px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, no shadow; square 32px rows, Fog under the highlighted row and Mist while pressed, section labels in the secondary ink, and Mireye's check at the end of a chosen row.

items.name: empty-value
items.useFor: Use `EmptyValue` (and the constants) wherever data components show a missing value, so the wording never drifts. Never a dash or a blank.
items.title: Empty value
items.description: Words for values that are not there ("Not screened", "Not recorded", "None on record"), in 72 percent Forest.

items.name: empty
items.useFor: Use where a list, map panel or report has nothing to show yet (No sites yet, No parcels match, No site selected). Use EmptyMark for the first-run state of a main view and EmptyMedia variant="icon" with a Phosphor glyph for a filtered or selection state. Say what is missing and what to do next; offer at most one action.
items.source: Brand principles (thin rules with nodes at their crossings) and the Diamond node, for a designer's review
items.title: Empty
items.description: A centered empty state: the survey node (an outlined diamond where two 1px rules cross) or a square glyph tile, a 16px regular title, a muted line and one action.

items.name: error-page
items.useFor: Use as the app's or site's error boundary page. Pass `code`, `title`, `retry` and `status` (null when there is no status page).
constraints: Stack traces or error ids as the headline
items.source: Derived: the website has only a not-found page; this keeps its layout (not-found.tsx and NotFoundScene).
items.title: Error page
items.description: The server error page (500, 503): the code in DM Mono, one line that owns the fault, a way to try again and the status page, beside an empty survey plate.

items.name: faq-section
items.useFor: Use at the foot of the pricing or product page. Pass `groups` of question and answer. Keep answers to two sentences.
constraints: Plus or minus icons that move on hover
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): PricingQuestions and faq-brand.css (group name left, questions right)
items.title: FAQ section
items.description: Questions in groups: the group name on the left, its questions on the right as an accordion ruled in Mist; the first starts open.

items.name: feature-grid
items.useFor: Use for three to six capabilities of equal weight. One column on a phone, two on a tablet, three on wide screens (`columns={2}` keeps two). Keep each description to one sentence and the value to a few mono words.
constraints: Cards with gaps instead of shared rules
Hover fills on cells that are not links
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): feature-rows.css and coverage-grid (cells on 1px rules, mono labels)
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: Features on a survey grid: cells share 1px Stone rules, each with a 20px glyph, a mono index, a 16px title, a muted line and a mono value.

items.name: field
items.useFor: Use Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription and FieldError around any control; FieldGroup to stack fields; FieldSet and FieldLegend for a titled group; orientation horizontal for a checkbox, radio or switch beside its label; FieldLabel around a Field for choice cards; FieldSeparator for or between two ways in.
constraints: A red label on an invalid field (only the line and the message turn brick)
items.source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): the label, the field and the helper under the Range
items.title: Field
items.description: Mireye's form layout: a 12px label in 80% Forest 8px above the control, fields 16px apart, a 12px description in 72% Forest or a 12px brick error below. Legends are 16px Forest. A label that wraps a whole field is a choice card in the cut frame, Forest-lined on Fog when chosen.

items.name: fit-score
items.useFor: Use the bar in tables and Compare headers, the chip on cards and the ring on the parcel record. Pass `value` (null when never screened) and `loading` while a screen runs. Levels are words, never colors: Strong fit (80 and up), Moderate (60 to 79), Weak (under 60).
constraints: A percent sign; it is a score
items.source: Not in Figma yet; built from Ticks, Tag and the Dial's geometry
items.title: Fit score
items.description: How well a site meets the buyer's requirements, 0 to 100: a tick bar, a chip or a ring, with the level in words.

items.name: form
items.useFor: Use for a form with validation, such as site criteria. Wrap the control in FormControl so it gets the id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid; put FormMessage last. End with one default key with `arrow`, and set its `loading` while the form submits.
constraints: Validating on every keystroke before the first submit
A message that replaces the label
items.source: Drawn from Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107)
items.title: Form
items.description: A react-hook-form form in Mireye's field layout: each FormItem is a 12px label, the control 8px under it, then a 12px description or a brick message. A failing field turns only its control's line and its message brick.

items.name: hero-section
items.useFor: Use once at the top of a home or product page. `layout="split"` puts the copy beside the plate on wide screens; `center` stacks them. Pass `visual` to replace the plate (a product screen), or null for copy only. Keep the title to one sentence.
constraints: Gradients or glows behind the title
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HomeHero (notice tag, one-line title, short line, header-sized actions)
items.title: Hero section
items.description: The website hero: a notice chip with a solid node, the display title, one line, the Forest key and an outlined key, a mono line, and the survey plate beside or under the copy.

items.name: home-page
items.useFor: Start a marketing home page from it. Each section takes its own props (`hero`, `features`, `faq`...) and any optional section can be left out with null. Replace the sample copy; keep one Forest key per screen.
constraints: Real customer names or quotes without permission
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HomePage section order (hero, customers, numbers, coverage, platform, voices, closing)
items.title: Home page
items.description: The home page template: header, hero with the survey plate, logo strip, feature grid, testimonial, questions, the closing card and the footer, on one set of rails.

items.name: hover-card
items.useFor: Use to preview a linked thing in running text (a substation's voltage, owner and distance) without leaving the page. The link still works on click.
constraints: The only place a fact appears
Actions or fields inside the card
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the popover's panel
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: The popover's panel (Bone, 6px cut corner, 1px Stone line, no shadow) shown after a 400ms dwell on a link, with a short preview of what it points to.

items.name: icons
items.useFor: Use these where Figma draws them: ArrowRightIcon after a key's label (its `head` turned 90 degrees is the select chevron), CheckIcon in the checkbox, PlusIcon for add (turned 45 degrees it closes), ParcelIcon before coordinates. For everything else use Phosphor at regular weight. Sizes are Figma's; they render at the product scale.
constraints: Mixing these with a filled Phosphor weight
A chevron icon where the arrow head serves
items.source: Figma UI boards: buttons 442:3, checkbox 442:161, search field 442:141
items.title: Icons
items.description: Mireye's own glyphs from Figma: the arrow (and its head alone), the check, the plus and the parcel.

items.name: input-group
items.useFor: Use for a search field (the parcel glyph first, as in Figma), a value with a unit or a fixed prefix (APN), a field with a live check (the Dial, then a check or a brick x) or a copy key, and a question box with a caption above or below.
constraints: A spinner other than the Dial
Addons that change the field's height
items.source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): the Search row and the unit slot
items.title: Input group
items.description: A field with things inside it: the field's frame around a borderless input, with addons 16px in: the parcel glyph, a unit in 13px Forest, a Dial while a check runs, a key hint, an icon key, or a Fog segment behind a Stone rule. Addons can sit above or below a textarea.

items.name: input-otp
items.useFor: Use for sign-in and verification codes. Set `maxLength` and `pattern` (REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS for numeric codes); split long codes into groups with a separator. Say where the code was sent below it.
constraints: One field per character that the reader must tab through
A code shown in the sans face
items.source: Not in Figma; drawn from the field (442:107)
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code: one 36px square per character, each the field's frame with the compact 6px cut, 8px apart, with 16px DM Mono characters. The next slot's line turns Forest with a blinking caret; invalid turns every line brick.

items.name: input
items.useFor: Use for one line of text or a number: a site name, a parcel number, a size. Put a Label 8px above it (or use Field). Pass `unit` when the value has one, and a Unit Select when the reader can change it. Set aria-invalid when the value is rejected and say why below it. For search, use Input Group with the parcel glyph.
constraints: A placeholder as the only label
A focus ring around the field (the line turns Forest instead)
A hover effect on the field
A unit typed into the value
items.source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): Default, Focused, Filled and Search rows
items.title: Input
items.description: Mireye's field: 36px, Bone inside a 1px Stone line with the 8px cut corner, 13px Forest text and a Slate placeholder 16px in. Focus turns the line Forest (no ring); invalid turns it brick; read-only is Fog, disabled Mist. `unit` puts a unit after the value (ac, kV) or a Unit Select.

items.name: item
items.useFor: Use for rows in a list that are not a table: results (a site's image, name and DM Mono coordinates, Fog tags at the end), the sources behind an answer, or rail rows (size sm). Render a link or button with asChild so the row fills on hover; mark the current one with aria-current. Rule rows with ItemSeparator. Use outline for a standalone row, muted inside a Bone panel.
constraints: Hover fills on rows that do nothing
More than two tags per row
items.source: LAND data-table (the Leads sites list) and Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Sources
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of content: a site with its aerial, name, coordinates and tags; a source; a rail row. Square, Fog under the pointer, Mist when current.

items.name: kbd
items.useFor: Use to show a keyboard shortcut beside an action or in a tooltip, and inside a field for a search key. Group keys with KbdGroup.
items.source: Not in Figma; drawn in the brand's data face
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key: a square 20px cap with a 1px Stone line on Bone and the key in 12px DM Mono in 80% Forest. On Forest (a tooltip) its line turns Haze and its text Bone.

items.name: label
items.useFor: Use above every field, tied to it with htmlFor (or aria-labelledby for a Select or Combobox). Keep labels short nouns (Parcel size, Location). Beside a checkbox, radio or switch, prefer the control's own children as its label.
items.source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): Parcel size, Location
items.title: Label
items.description: A field's label: 12px regular in 80% Forest, 8px above its field. Beside a checkbox, radio or switch it becomes the control's own 13px Forest label. A required mark inside it is brick.

items.name: legal-page
items.useFor: Use for terms, privacy and security pages. Pass `sections` (id, title, paragraphs) and `effective`. The sample text is a placeholder, not legal advice.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): terms and privacy pages
items.title: Legal page
items.description: A legal page: the title and effective date in DM Mono, a contents list that stays in view on wide screens, then numbered sections at a 680px measure.

items.name: line-fill-loader
items.useFor: Use while data loads: `size={160}` for a panel, `size={40}` inline. `running={false}` with `frame` holds Figma's still frame.
constraints: Over a map; use the contour loader there
A bar chart that pretends to be data
items.source: Figma "UI · Loaders" (443:2): hero 443:52, frames 443:56 to 443:72
items.title: Line fill loader
items.description: The data loader: eleven lines rising into a bell that travels left to right.

items.name: list-detail-page
items.useFor: Use for any list of records with a detail view (sites, reports, searches). Pass `sites`, `defaultSelected` and `onAsk`. On a phone the list sits above the detail.
constraints: Opening the detail in a modal on wide screens
items.source: brand/reference product UI boards (Figma 442:2) and the library's product parts: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433), cited-fields, sources, site-chip, fit-score, status, tag
items.title: List detail page
items.description: Saved sites in the app shell: a filterable list (name, parcel ID in DM Mono, fit bar) beside the chosen site's name, coordinates, status, tags, survey plate, cited fields with sources and the composer with the site chip.

items.name: loader
items.useFor: Import either loader from here when a screen uses both; ContourLoader and LineFillLoader have their own entries with the details. NodeLoader, Dial and ParcelScan are separate.
constraints: Loaders without words saying what loads, outside a tile
items.source: Figma "UI · Loaders" (443:2)
items.title: Loader
items.description: Both drawn loaders from one module: ContourLoader for terrain and LineFillLoader for data.

items.name: logo-strip
items.useFor: Use under the hero to show who builds on the product. The defaults are placeholder names (Acme, Acme Labs...); pass real customer names only with their permission.
constraints: Real company names or logos without permission
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): CustomerLogoStrip layout (names in ruled cells); names are placeholders
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: Customer names between two section rules: a mono label, then quiet wordmarks (an outlined node and the name in Forest at 72%) in cells split by Mist rules.

items.name: map-controls
items.useFor: Put `MapControls` in the bottom-right corner, its bottom on the scale bar's line. Pass `onZoomIn` and `onZoomOut`; disable one at the zoom limit. `MapControlButton` is one key for other map actions, with a 16px glyph and an `aria-label`.
constraints: The 20px plus here; map glyphs are 16px
items.source: Figma "UI · Map marker" (443:395): 443:427 and 443:430
items.title: Map controls
items.description: Zoom in and zoom out: two square keys with the small cut, stacked in the map's bottom-right corner.

items.name: map-marker
items.useFor: Put `MapMarker` inside the map viewport with `x`, `y`, `value` and `coordinates`. Leave out the reading to show only lines and nodes. `variant="crosshair"` draws one crosshair with a framed node and the one-row tag beside it; `side="left"` near the right edge. `MapTag` is the tag alone.
constraints: More than one marker with a tag at once
Moving the offsets; only the point moves
items.source: Figma "UI · Map marker" (443:395): 443:406 to 443:420
items.title: Map marker
items.description: A survey point: two pairs of survey lines across the map, four nodes and a Forest tag with the reading.

items.name: map-scale
items.useFor: Put it in the map's bottom-left corner. `label` is the true distance the bar covers at the map's center ("640 ft"); a new zoom level changes the label, never the bar. On imagery make it Bone with `text-fg-inverse`.
constraints: A label that does not change with zoom
items.source: Figma "UI · Map marker" (443:395): Scale 443:423
items.title: Map scale
items.description: The scale bar: a 1px ruler with ticks and the distance its whole length covers.

items.name: map
items.useFor: Draw these on top of the product's map. On imagery, dim the photo with `ds-imagery`, use `tone="photo"` on the marker and a white scale. MapMarker fills its viewport; `x` and `y` are the point in viewport pixels. The example draws on live USGS orthoimagery and keeps its Forest ground offline.
constraints: Pins, drop shadows or round markers
A bright photo under the marks
items.source: Figma "UI · Map marker" (443:395) and the map exploration (449:2)
items.title: Map
items.description: The overlays on Mireye's map in one module: the survey marker and its tag, the scale bar and the zoom controls.

items.name: marker
items.useFor: Use between messages or rows to mark time (Yesterday, Oct 28), a change the agent made (Search widened to 25 mi), or where new results start (variant unread). Keep it one short line; links inside are underlined.
constraints: More than one unread marker in a list
items.source: Not in Figma: Mist and Forest rules from Cited fields (443:470), for a designer's review
items.title: Marker
items.description: A 12px muted note in a conversation or list: a date between Mist rules, an event with a glyph, or the Forest line where new results begin.

items.name: menubar
items.useFor: Use for an app-style command bar over a workspace (Site, Edit, Map) where people expect desktop menus. Keep it to a few short menu names. A long menu fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: A menubar for site navigation (use Navigation Menu)
Rounded keys or a pill track
A fade when moving between menus
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Bone cut frame of Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) and the dropdown menu's panel
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A Bone frame with the 6px cut corner holding square 32px menu keys (Fog under the pointer and while open), each opening the dropdown menu's panel; moving along the bar is instant.

items.name: message-scroller
items.useFor: Wrap a conversation: MessageScroller, then MessageScrollerViewport around MessageScrollerContent, one MessageScrollerItem per message, and a MessageScrollerButton. Give the scroller a fixed height (it fills its parent). Set scrollAnchor on the item the person just sent so the reply grows below it. Use MessageScrollerProvider to reach the scroller from outside (a composer), and the hooks useMessageScroller, useMessageScrollerScrollable and useMessageScrollerVisibility for custom controls. The thread fades at an edge (fade-y) where more messages scroll past it.
constraints: Sliding the jump key in and out
A shadow under the jump key
Scrolling away from what the reader is reading when a message arrives
A scroller without a fixed height
items.source: Not in Figma (no full chat screen yet): built for the agent chat parts of UI · Agent chat (443:433), for a designer's review
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A conversation's scroll area that opens at the newest message, stays pinned to it as messages arrive, and offers a square Bone Jump to latest key once the reader scrolls up.

items.name: message
items.useFor: Use for each turn of a conversation with the agent. Put the person's question in a default Bubble with align end on the Message, and the agent's answer in a ghost Bubble beside a Forest avatar holding a Diamond. Use MessageFooter for what backs the answer (Cited 3 sources). Group turns in MessageGroup.
constraints: Messages that slide or fade in
items.source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Message and Sources, at the product scale
items.title: Message
items.description: One message in an agent conversation: a square avatar, the sender and a DM Mono time, the bubbles and a muted footer.

items.name: mireye-mark
items.useFor: Use in a header or beside "Ask Mireye". It takes the text color: ink on light grounds, `text-fg-inverse` on Forest. Size it with a width and `h-auto`.
constraints: Recoloring it with a palette color
Placing it on imagery without a solid ground
items.source: Figma "Mireye mark" (27.17 by 20 on the UI boards)
items.title: Mireye mark
items.description: The Mireye logomark, two cut blocks, in the color of the text around it.

items.name: native-select
items.useFor: Use where the platform picker is better: phones, very long lists, forms without script. Otherwise use Select.
constraints: A native select for a choice that needs search
A custom chevron other than the brand arrow
items.source: Drawn from Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107)
items.title: Native select
items.description: The browser's own select dressed as Mireye's: the field's frame (36px, the cut) with the value 16px in and the brand arrow's head turned down at the right.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.useFor: Use for a site's top navigation when a section has several pages worth describing (Tools: site search, grid access, interconnection, fit score). Plain links sit beside the triggers with navigationMenuTriggerStyle.
constraints: A caret that turns or moves on hover
More than two columns of links
Rounded keys or a shadow on the panel
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dropdown menu's panel and rows
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Square 36px nav keys with a still caret, Fog under the pointer and while open, and a panel in the dropdown menu's frame (Bone, 6px cut corner, 1px Stone line, no shadow) with square link rows.

items.name: newsletter-section
items.useFor: Use near the foot of a blog index, a changelog or the home page. Pass `onSubscribe(email)`; the section shows sending, done and invalid states.
constraints: A success message that hides the field's label

items.title: Newsletter section
items.description: A sign-up for updates: the title and one line beside an email field and the Forest key, with the result said under the field.

items.name: node-loader
items.useFor: Use while a short step runs: inline at its default size, or `size="sm"` before a waiting line in chat ("Reading the parcel's records"). It is a status named "Loading". `running={false}` holds one of Figma's five frames.
constraints: A loader with no words beside it in chat
items.source: Figma "UI · Loaders, agent" (443:234): Nodes 443:241 and 443:249 to 443:281
items.title: Node loader
items.description: Three survey nodes that fill in turn: the inline and chat loader.

items.name: not-found-page
items.useFor: Use as the app's or site's not-found page. Pass `title`, `description` and `home`.
constraints: Jokes or illustrations off the brand
A search field as the only way out
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): not-found page and NotFoundScene (the survey scene)
items.title: Not found page
items.description: The 404 page: the code in DM Mono, one line that says the page is off the map, the way home (the Forest key) and to the docs, beside an empty survey plate.

items.name: page-section
items.useFor: Use as the outer wrapper of any website section so pages read as one survey sheet. Pass label, title and intro for the head (title left, intro right on wide screens) and the section's content as children. Pass `closing` on the last section of a page to draw the bottom rule. SECTION_GUTTER, SECTION_COLUMN and SECTION_INSET align anything else (a header) to the rails; SITE_LINK and SiteLockup are the website's link and lockup.
constraints: Sections without the rails on a page that has them
Nodes anywhere but where two rules cross
