items.title: Page section
items.description: The survey frame every website section sits in: 1px Stone rails at the content edges, a rule edge to edge at the top, a solid Forest diamond at each crossing, an optional mono label, title and intro.

items.name: pagination
items.useFor: Use under a long list of sites or records when it is split into pages. Pass bar to sit it under a table. Show the first and last page, the pages around the current one and PaginationEllipsis between. Give Previous aria-disabled on the first page and Next on the last.
constraints: Infinite scroll and pages on one list
items.source: Not in Figma: built from the rail's Fog hover and Mist current row and the arrow of UI · Buttons (442:3), for a designer's review
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Square 32px page keys that fill with Fog under the pointer; the current page sits on Mist; Previous and Next carry Mireye's arrow.

items.name: parcel-scan
items.useFor: Use while a site's map or record loads: the default size in a panel, `size="sm"` in a tile. It draws on a live USGS orthoimagery tile; pass `image` for your own, and it reads on the Forest ground until the photo arrives or offline. `running={false}` shows Figma's still frame on the Bone contour tile.
constraints: A bright, undimmed photo under the marks
Placing it on a light ground while running
items.source: Figma "UI · Loaders, agent" (443:234): Map 443:290 and Parcel scan 443:291, sm 443:301 to 443:321
items.title: Parcel scan
items.description: The map and site loader: a parcel drawn on aerial imagery, its corners, outline, survey lines and hatch, in a loop.

items.name: popover
items.useFor: Use for a small form or detail tied to one control (rename a site, set a buffer distance) that keeps the page in view. Use PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle and PopoverDescription for its head.
constraints: Long forms or several steps (use Dialog or Sheet)
A popover that opens on hover (use Hover Card)
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Bone cut frame of Figma UI · Inputs (442:107)
items.title: Popover
items.description: A Bone panel with the 6px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, no shadow, 16px of padding, a 13px medium title over a line in the secondary ink; it grows from its trigger in 150ms.

items.name: pricing-page
items.useFor: Use for /pricing. Pass `plans` (through PricingTable's props), `planNames` and `rows` for the comparison, and `faq` for billing questions.
constraints: More than one Forest key per plan row
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): PricingPage, PricingPlans, PricingQuestions and pricing.css
items.title: Pricing page
items.description: The pricing page template: the page title, the plans with one yearly switch, a ruled comparison table with values in DM Mono, billing questions and the closing card.

items.name: pricing-table
items.useFor: Use on the pricing page, or as a section of the home page. Pass `plans` (monthly and yearly prices, or a quote) and mark one `featured`. Every other plan gets an outlined key.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): PricingPlans and pricing.css (plan row, one billing switch for every paid plan)
items.title: Pricing table
items.description: Plans in cut frames: price in the display size with its unit in DM Mono, the included usage, solid-node bullets; the featured plan has a Forest line and the one Forest key, and one switch bills every plan yearly.

items.name: product-page
items.useFor: Use for a product or feature page. Pass `rows` of label, title, description and a `visual` (a library item with sample data). Keep pictures to real parts, never screenshots.
constraints: Screenshots or stock photos as pictures
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): ProductPages and FeatureRow (copy beside a product picture, alternating)
items.title: Product page
items.description: A product or features page: the hero with a cited answer as its picture, alternating feature rows that each show a real library part (a request, cited fields, the buy box checks), the field grid, questions and the closing card.

items.name: progress
items.useFor: Use for a known amount of work the agent reports (Loading terrain, sources read, parcels matched). Give it a label, which names the bar and shows the percentage; without one, pass aria-label. The fill counts up a tick at a time. For a wait with no known end, use Spinner.
constraints: Progress for something that takes under a second
items.source: Figma UI · Progress (442:213): Determinate, title 442:222, value 442:223, bar 442:224
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate tick bar: 1px lines every 6px, Forest where done and Stone ahead, under a 16px title and its percentage.

items.name: questionnaire
items.useFor: Use when the agent or a setup flow needs a few answers in a row (a buy box: how much land, what must be near, when). Pass the questions as items to Questionnaire, then render a QuestionnaireItem per question with a QuestionnaireTitle, a QuestionnaireDescription, QuestionnaireChoices of QuestionnaireChoice (add QuestionnaireInput for another answer) and a QuestionnaireError; end with QuestionnaireActions holding Previous, Skip, Next and Submit. Mark required questions; set multiple to allow several answers. onSubmit receives the native form event: read the answers with FormData.
constraints: More than one question on screen
A required question without its error message
A filled card for a chosen answer
items.source: Figma UI · Controls (442:145): the diamond radio and the checkbox; UI · Inputs (442:107): the field's cut frame; UI · Progress (442:213): the tick bar
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questions asked one at a time: Bone cut-frame choice cards with the diamond radio or the square checkbox and a shortcut key, a typed answer, a count over the tick bar, and Previous, Skip and Next.

items.name: radio-group
items.useFor: Use for one choice among two to five options that all need to be seen (zoning, a search radius). Pass each label as the item's children. For more options use Select; for a view switch use Toggle Group.
constraints: A radio group with one option (use Checkbox)
Options chosen by default when there is no safe default
items.source: Figma "UI · Controls" (442:145): Industrial, selected and not
items.title: Radio group
items.description: The diamond radio: a 16px outline diamond, Stone when not chosen and Forest when chosen with a solid 7px Forest diamond in its center. Its label is 13px Forest 12px after it; options stack 12px apart.

items.name: range
items.useFor: Use under a numeric field when the value has a known span (Within 40 to 120 ac). Share one value between the field and the ruler, so typing moves the handle and dragging writes the field. Give it an aria-label.
constraints: A Range without a field or text showing the exact value
items.source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): Range 442:134 and Helper 442:137 under the Filled field
items.title: Range
items.description: A tick ruler for one value under a field: 1px Stone ticks 8px tall every 6px, a 1.5px Forest handle that snaps to the nearest tick, and 12px helper text in 80% Forest. The ticks rise like a ruler under a lens near the pointer and the handle.

items.name: requirement-checks
items.useFor: Use on a parcel record. Put `RequirementCheck` rows (result, field, requirement, value, kind, source) inside `RequirementChecks` with a title and summary. A failed Must requirement fills its row Fog and says Fail in Medium. Rows still screening say Screening and land in place as results arrive. Narrow containers stack each row.
constraints: Hiding unknown readings; they say Unknown
Sorting by result; keep buy box order
items.source: Not in Figma yet; built from the product survey of the parcel record and existing marks
items.title: Requirement checks
items.description: A site checked against a buy box: one row per requirement with its result, rule, value, weight and source.

items.name: resizable
items.useFor: Use for a workspace whose panes people size themselves (a site list beside the map, a map above a report). Give each ResizablePanel a defaultSize in percent and a sensible minSize; add withHandle when the edge needs to be found.
constraints: Panels that can collapse to nothing without a minSize
items.source: Not in Figma: the 1px Stone line of every edge, for a designer's review
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by a 1px Stone rule that turns Forest while dragged or focused; it can be dragged or moved with the arrow keys.

items.name: result-mark
items.useFor: Use inside RequirementChecks and CompareMatrix, or wherever a single check shows. The mark shows how sure the reading is (a solid diamond is a reading, an outline is none, bars are a screen running); `ResultLabel` always says the outcome and reserves the widest word.
constraints: Green and red for pass and fail
items.source: Not in Figma yet; built from existing marks (status 442:177, diamond)
items.title: Result mark
items.description: The mark and word for one requirement checked against a site: Pass, Fail, Unknown or Screening.

items.name: scroll-area
items.useFor: Use for a panel with its own scroll (a list of sites or counties, the sources of an answer, a row of tags) inside a fixed-height layout. Give it a height (h-72, flex-1 in a column). Add a horizontal ScrollBar for wide content. Its edges fade (fade-xy) where more content scrolls past them, either way; nothing is cut off by a hard edge.
constraints: Nested scroll areas in the same direction
Hiding the bar entirely on desktop
items.source: Not in Figma: Stone and Slate from the product greys (442:2), for a designer's review
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A region that scrolls inside the page with a thin square Stone bar that steps to Slate under the pointer.

items.name: select
items.useFor: Use for one choice among a known list of up to about fifteen (a state, a voltage, a sort). Put a Label above it with aria-labelledby. Pass `name` to submit the value with its form (FormData). Use size sm in dense toolbars. For long or searchable lists use Combobox; for two to five short options use Radio Group or Toggle Group. A long list fades at an edge (fade-y) where more options scroll past it.
constraints: A check mark or circle for the chosen row (it is the diamond)
A select for a yes or no choice
items.source: Drawn from Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107) and the design's unit list
items.title: Select
items.description: Mireye's select: the field's frame (36px, Bone, 1px Stone line, the cut) with the value and the brand arrow's head turned down. Its list floats 4px under it in the same frame: 28px rows in 80% Forest, the highlighted one a Fog plate with the small cut, the chosen one full Forest with a solid diamond.

items.name: separator
items.useFor: Use between groups inside a Bone panel (rows of values, the parts of a card, toolbar groups with orientation="vertical"). Set strong for the rule under a table head or at the edge of a panel. It is decorative unless you set decorative={false}.
items.source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): the Mist rules of Cited fields (443:470)
items.title: Separator
items.description: A 1px rule in Mist inside a panel, or Stone at a panel's edge (strong), across or down.

items.name: settings-page
items.useFor: Use for workspace or account settings. Pass `members`, `keys` and `onSave`. Keep Save changes the one Forest key; other actions are outlined or text.
items.source: brand/reference product UI boards (Figma 442:2) and the library's product parts: field, input, switch, table, avatar (Figma UI · Inputs 442:79)
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Settings in the app shell: a section list that stays in view, then workspace fields, members, API keys in DM Mono, notification switches and the destructive action alone in the last card.

items.name: sheet
items.useFor: Use for editing or reading something beside the page without losing it (a site's requirements, a parcel's details). Side sheets are 384px wide; top and bottom sheets take their content's height. A sheet taller than the screen fades at an edge (fade-y) where more content scrolls past it.
constraints: A sheet for a quick confirmation (use Alert Dialog)
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dialog's panel and close key
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A Bone panel flush with an edge of the screen, square, with a 1px Stone line on its inner edge and no shadow, on the page under Forest at 40 percent; it slides on the drawer curve.

items.name: sidebar
items.useFor: Use for an app's main navigation beside the canvas (Ask, Map, Saved sites, Reports, then labelled groups such as Layers). Wrap the app in SidebarProvider; put the lockup in SidebarHeader, groups of SidebarMenuItem in SidebarContent and Help and the account in SidebarFooter. Mark the current row with isActive. Use collapsible="icon" to fold to glyphs (give each row a tooltip), variant="secondary" for a second rail of projects on the canvas, and SidebarMenuBadge for a count or a short mark. SidebarContent fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
items.source: Mireye docs site spec (the 212px Bone rail, square rows, framed group chips) and the rail's Fog hover and Mist current, for a designer's review
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app's rail: 212px of Bone with a 1px Stone edge, square 32px rows (Fog under the pointer, Mist when current), group labels as 1px-framed chips, a Forest count; it folds to glyphs, slides away or opens as a sheet on phones.

items.name: site-chip
items.useFor: Use in the chat composer (ChatInput's `site`) or above it. `onRemove` adds a remove key with a 24px hit area; the chip leaves before it calls back. When the label changes, the chip eases to its new width and the new coordinates rise in. `icon={false}` drops the parcel icon.
constraints: Free text that is not a location
A chip without a way to clear it in a composer
items.source: Figma "UI · Agent chat" (443:433): 443:458 and 443:503
items.title: Site chip
items.description: The site a question is about, as coordinates in a Fog chip with the small cut and an optional remove key.

items.name: site-footer
items.useFor: Use at the foot of every website page, as its last section. Pass `columns` of links, `legal` and a mono `meta` (a status).
constraints: Social icons that move on hover
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): SiteFooter (Products, Solutions, Company, Explore and Connect columns, legal row)
items.title: Site footer
items.description: The website footer: the lockup and one line, link columns under mono labels and the legal row under a Mist rule; it closes the page's rails.

items.name: site-header
items.useFor: Use at the top of every website page. Pass `links`, the `current` href, `signIn` and `cta`. It is sticky on Bone with a Stone rule under it. The phone menu opens in place without motion.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): SiteHeader and site-header.css
items.title: Site header
items.description: The website header: the lockup, page links (Forest at 80%, Forest when current with a Forest rule), Sign in and the Forest key, aligned to the section rails; a menu key below 768px.

items.name: skeleton
items.useFor: Use in the shape of what will load: table rows with their site image and tags, cited fields, a card's values. Match each part's size; everything is square. It waits before it appears, so a quick load never flashes it.
constraints: Skeletons for content already on screen
A skeleton for a single button
items.source: Built from the palette: Fog and Mist, Figma's hover and pressed fills (442:2)
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A square Fog block in the shape of what will load, breathing toward Mist; it shows only after 450ms.

items.name: slider
items.useFor: Use to set a number or a span quickly where the exact value shows beside it (a search radius, a size span). Show the value next to the label. For a value under a field with helper text and the snapping lens of the design, use Range.
constraints: A filled bar or a round knob
A slider without its value shown
A slider for a choice between named options
items.source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): the Range under the Filled field
items.title: Slider
items.description: A ruler: 1px Stone ticks 6px apart in a 16px band, with a 1.5px Forest line as the handle. One value shows only the handle; a range also draws the ticks between its handles in Forest. Vertical turns the ruler on its side.

items.name: sonner
items.useFor: Use for a short report on something that just happened (a survey finished, an export failed), with an Undo or Retry action when there is one. Mount Toaster once near the root and call toast() from anywhere.
constraints: Information people must act on (use Alert Dialog)
A circle or a filled glyph as the status mark
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Bone cut frame of Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) and the status diamonds of Figma UI · Status and tags (442:177)
items.title: Sonner
items.description: A Bone panel with the 8px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, no shadow, a 6px diamond status mark (Fern success, brick error, outlined warning and information, the Dial while loading), a 13px medium title and square keys.

items.name: sources
items.useFor: List sources with `Sources` and `Source number={n}`; cite inline with `SourceRef size="inline"`. Inside `SourceGroup`, pointing at or focusing a cited value marks every chip with that number in Forest and steps the other sources back. `cut={false}` draws the chip square for tables.
constraints: Footnote links in a new tab color
A fill on the row that is pointed at
items.source: Figma "UI · Agent chat" (443:433): rows 443:490 to 443:501, refs 443:473 to 443:487
items.title: Sources
items.description: The numbered sources behind an agent answer, and SourceRef, the Fog chip that points a cited value at one.

items.name: spinner
items.useFor: Use inside what is working, beside a word that says what is happening (Matching the parcel), or on an icon key that is loading. Default is about 14px for text and keys; lg (22px) sits beside a panel title; xl (84px) is the one loader on an empty screen. For a known amount, use Progress; in a labelled button, prefer its tick walk.
constraints: A spinner with no words beside it
A full-page spinner for a short wait
items.source: Figma UI · Buttons (442:3): icon button Loading (442:76); UI · Loaders (443:2): the 36px frames 443:103 to 443:207 and the hero 443:77
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The Dial: ticks around a circle, the head in Forest and the tail fading to Mist, turning one tick per step.

items.name: stats-section
items.useFor: Use for two to four figures right after the hero or a logo strip. Every figure needs a source the page can show. Two columns on a phone, four on wide screens.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HomeNumbers and home-numbers.css (four numbers on the strip's columns)
items.title: Stats section
items.description: Big calm numbers rail to rail: a mono unit, a large number and one line in each cell, columns parted by 1px Stone rules.

items.name: status
items.useFor: Use for the state of a site or a screen in a list. The pill keeps one width in every state, and changes swap the mark and word in place. Wrap it in your own `role="status"` when one status updates in place.
items.source: Figma "UI · Status and tags" (442:177): Verified 442:187, Processing 442:192, Queued 442:197
items.title: Status
items.description: A status pill: Verified, Loading or Queued, with a diamond or bars as its mark and the cut frame.

items.name: steps-section
items.useFor: Use for three to five steps of a process. Across on wide screens, down on a phone.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HowItWorks and how-it-works.css (the step line and its nodes)
items.title: Steps section
items.description: How it works: numbered steps along a 1px Stone line, a solid diamond at each, a mono index, a title and one line.

items.name: steps
items.useFor: Use for a fixed sequence of stages ("Parcel, Power, Water, Report"). Pass the labels and `current`, the stage in progress; `steps.length` means all done. Labels reach half their width past the row's ends, so leave room, or use `labelAlign="edges"`. When `current` moves on, the finished node stamps, the line travels and the next node lights on arrival.
constraints: Clickable steps; this shows progress, not navigation
items.source: Figma "UI · Progress" (442:213), row "Steps"
items.title: Steps
items.description: Survey nodes joined by a line: the stages of a run, done, current and pending.

items.name: stream-text
items.useFor: Wrap streamed text: `<StreamText text={...} onDone={...} />`. 24ms a word, a 200ms fade on the ease-out curve; under reduced motion the text appears at once.
items.title: Stream text
items.description: The words of an answer fading in one after another, as a streamed reply arrives.

items.name: surface
items.useFor: Wrap an embedded panel or a preview in Surface so its overlays render inside it. Pick the Fog ground for a panel inside a Bone one.
items.title: Surface
items.description: A Bone or Fog ground that also keeps the dialogs, menus and tooltips opened inside it.

items.name: survey-plate
items.useFor: Use where a page or shell needs a map picture without loading imagery: a hero, a 404, an auth panel, a dashboard's map panel. Give it a size (an aspect ratio or a height). Parcels and the marker are placed in percent of the plate. In the product, the real map with `map` marks replaces it.
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): hatched parcels and survey grid (map-shape.css, hero-crosshair.css); Figma map exploration (449:2) for the crosshair
items.title: Survey plate
items.description: A drawn survey sheet: contours, a 1px grid with outlined nodes at the crossings, hatched parcels, the chosen parcel in a Forest line, the crosshair marker with its reading, coordinates and a scale.

items.name: switch
items.useFor: Use for a setting that applies at once, such as a map layer (Terrain). Pass the label as children. Use size sm in dense rows. For an option applied on submit use Checkbox.
constraints: A switch that needs a Save key to apply
items.source: Figma "UI · Controls" (442:145), where it is called Toggle: Terrain, on and off
items.title: Switch
items.description: A square 32 by 16 track with no cut: Bone with a Stone line and a Mist knob when off, Forest with a Bone knob when on. The knob slides in 200ms on the strong ease-out; the track's color fades over 150ms. Its label is 13px Forest 12px after it.

items.name: table
items.useFor: Use for a short, fixed list of records to read (substations near a parcel, the parcels in an assembled site). Align numbers right with tabular-nums and units in the cell (138 kV, 0.8 mi); set parcel IDs and coordinates in DM Mono. Mark a selected row with data-state="selected" and a row that opens a record with data-interactive. For sorting, filtering, selection or paging, use Data Table. A table wider than its container fades at the side (fade-x) where more columns scroll past it.
items.source: LAND data-table (the Leads sites table) and Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Cited fields rules
items.title: Table
items.description: A table ruled like a survey sheet: 12px head labels over a 1px Stone rule, 44px rows ruled in Mist, no frame and no head fill; framed puts it in the Bone cut frame.

items.name: tabs
items.useFor: Use line tabs to switch between views of one thing (Parcel, Power, Water, Terrain on a site). Use variant="segmented" for two to four short choices that change how the same data is shown (Map, List, Compare); pass full to share the width. Labels are words, one or two each.
constraints: A mark that animates on first paint or on resize
items.source: Not in Figma: built from the system's 1px lines and the rail's Mist current row, for a designer's review
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Line tabs on a 1px Mist rule with a 1px Forest line under the selected one, and segmented tabs in a Stone-lined Bone track with the selected tab on Mist.

items.name: tag
items.useFor: Use for the values of a site in records, cards and lists. It is static text, not a control. Pass a width class to fix the width; the label stays left.
constraints: A remove cross inside a tag
items.source: Figma "UI · Status and tags" (442:177): nodes 442:202 to 442:211
items.title: Tag
items.description: A filled data tag for one site value ("345 kV", "41.2 ac", "Zone X"): Fog with the small cut corner.

items.name: testimonial-section
items.useFor: Use once on a page for one approved quote. The defaults are a fictional person at a placeholder company. Keep the quote under 40 words and the figures to three.
constraints: Real people or quotes without approval
items.source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): HomeVoices and home-numbers.css (mono figures over muted labels); person and quote are fictional
items.title: Testimonial section
items.description: One customer's words set at 24px regular, the person under it (square initials, name, role and company) and the figures the quote is about in DM Mono.

items.name: textarea
items.useFor: Use for notes and questions to the agent: site notes, criteria in words. Put a Label above it. For a box with a caption or actions inside, use Input Group with a textarea.
constraints: A fixed height that scrolls a short note
items.source: Drawn from Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107)
items.title: Textarea
items.description: The field for more than a line: the field's frame and states with 13px Forest text on 18px lines, 8px above and below. It grows with its content from 72px and is not resized by hand.

items.name: ticks
items.useFor: Use for any share or count drawn as a measure: progress, a fit score, a loading key's walk. Set `pitch` (6px for bars, 4px for the text button's underline), and `value` (0 to 1) or `filled` (a number of lines, so no tick is half lit). `on` and `off` take brand color variables: Forest over Stone, or Mist for empty.
items.source: Figma "UI · Progress" (442:213) and the Buttons board (442:3) loading state
items.title: Ticks
items.description: A row of 1px vertical lines at a fixed pitch: the system's measuring language for progress, loading keys and scores.

items.name: toast
items.useFor: Use where an app already uses shadcn's useToast API. Prefer Sonner for new work.
constraints: A new toast system beside Sonner
items.source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Sonner toasts
items.title: Toast
items.description: The Radix toast drawn as the Sonner toasts: a Bone panel with the 8px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, a 6px Forest diamond, a 13px medium title and a square framed action; destructive is drawn in brick.

items.name: toggle-group
items.useFor: Use for switching a view (Map, List, Compare), a unit or a distance band, with two to five short options. Use type single for one choice and multiple for layers. For more options or long labels use Select or Radio Group. A row too wide for its container fades at the side (fade-x) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: A sliding or animated chosen item
Icons without labels unless each has an aria-label
items.source: Not in Figma; drawn from "UI · Buttons" (442:3) and the field frame (442:107)
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A choice among a few: a segmented track in the field's frame (36px, Bone, 1px Stone line, the cut) whose chosen item is a Forest key with a Bone label. The outline variant is a row of framed toggles, joined with spacing 0.

items.name: toggle
items.useFor: Use for one on or off option on a toolbar or map (show terrain, show parcel lines). Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label. For a setting in a form use Switch; for one choice among a few use Toggle Group.
constraints: A Forest-filled toggle outside a Toggle Group track
Movement or a size change when pressed
A toggle that runs an action (use Button)
items.source: Not in Figma; drawn from the keys on "UI · Buttons" (442:3)
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A key that stays pressed: 36px with the compact 6px cut and an 80% Forest label; a Fog fill steps in under the pointer and on it holds Mist with a Forest label. The outline variant is the framed key, on with a Forest line on Fog.

items.name: tooltip
items.useFor: Use to name an icon key in a few words (Zoom in, Measure distance) or explain a term (spare capacity). Wrap a toolbar or page in TooltipProvider so neighboring tooltips open at once after the first.
constraints: Essential information only in a tooltip
More than a line or two
A Bone tooltip or one with an arrow
items.source: Figma Tooltip (443:418) on the map boards (443:234, 443:395): the Forest map tag with the 10px cut, here at the product scale
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Mireye's map tag as a label: a Forest tag with the 6px cut corner, no arrow, 12px Bone text, at least 28px tall and at most 256px wide; it only fades.

items.name: trace
items.useFor: Use to show what the agent did or is doing to answer (Matched the parcel, Checked the flood zone, Sampled elevation and slope), in the past tense once done. Lead each TraceLine with a TraceNode, or a TraceIcon when the tool matters. Set status running, pending or error. Put a step with detail in TraceCollapsible, its line inside TraceCollapsibleTrigger. Wrap a line in a link or button to make it open something.
constraints: Circles or check marks for steps
A spinner on every running step
A chevron that moves on hover
items.source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Steps 443:445 to 443:453; UI · Loaders, agent (443:234): the current node
items.title: Trace
items.description: An agent's steps as the Figma chat steps: an outlined diamond node and a 13px label; a running step breathes a node inside and shimmers its label; steps open to their detail on a 1px rule.

items.name: typography
items.useFor: Use for running text and document pages (a site report, a method note). H1 is the page title, H3 a section or progress title, Lead the line under a page title, Muted an annotation. Set parcel IDs, coordinates and commands in TypographyInlineCode. For data, use Table.
constraints: Body text above 14px in the product
items.source: Brand type rules (Gilroy Regular and Medium, 1.4 line height) and Figma UI · Progress (442:213): the 24px title, at the product scale
items.title: Typography
items.description: Mireye's type as components: Gilroy at 400 and 500 only, a 24px page title down to the 12px caption, DM Mono on Fog for IDs and coordinates, quotes on a 1px Forest rule.

items.name: unit-select
items.useFor: Pass it as an Input's `unit` when the same quantity reads in more than one unit (acres and hectares). Convert the value when the unit changes, so the quantity stays the same. Keep the list to four units or fewer. A long list fades at an edge (fade-y) where more options scroll past it.
constraints: A unit select on a value with one sensible unit (kV)
Keeping the number when the unit changes
A plate or cut on the closed button
items.source: Not in Figma yet; sits in the field's unit slot (442:107)
items.title: Unit select
items.description: The unit after a field's value as a quiet button: the short unit and the brand arrow's head turned down, no plate at rest, Fog under the pointer and Mist while open. Its list is the select's, 4px under the field on its right edge; a new unit rises 4px into place.

items.name: use-loop-frame
items.useFor: Use `useLoopFrame(frame, count, running, ms)` in frame-based loaders and `usePrefersReducedMotion()` to hold motion still.
items.title: Loop frame
items.description: Hooks for loaders: step through frames while running, and follow the reduced-motion setting live.

items.name: utils
